utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Mina, before I help with the repair drive, can you confirm what needs repairing and when Rosa has it scheduled?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I don’t have Rosa’s schedule confirmed yet, Hana — I only know we’re sorting donated parts by the entrance tables, type first, with damaged or missing pieces set aside.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mina — I’ll hold off on planning until Rosa confirms the schedule and repair list, but I can note the parts-sorting setup for now.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Dane, happy to help with the repair drive — do you need me to bring my drill and hammer, or pitch in on a specific repair?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Sam — yes, please bring the drill and hammer. I’m finishing the donation table now, so once you’re here we can check with Vik or Leo on which repair needs you first.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll bring the drill and hammer and check in with Vik or Leo when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Kira, I’ve only got confirmed that screwdrivers, pliers, and tape measures are covered so far—do you know the final time or any missing supplies I can safely pass along?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Not yet, Vik — I’m still waiting for Pia or Ira to confirm the exact time and drop-off spot. Please hold off sharing anything beyond the covered tools until we have that directly.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, Kira — I’ll keep it to the covered tools for now and wait for Pia or Ira to confirm the time and drop-off spot before passing anything else along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Faye, I’m just pulling the repair needs and tool list together now, then I’ll match folks to what’s still missing. Are you able to help Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can’t do Saturday morning with the school schedule, and I heard Rosa moved the drive to Sunday at the community center—if that’s still right, I can help line up parents and bring the sign-up sheet then.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Faye — I’d heard Saturday, so I’ll check the bulletin and confirm with Rosa before we spread the word. If it is Sunday at the community center, your help lining up parents and bringing the sign-up sheet would be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Cleo, the confirmed repair drive I have is at the school gym right after pickup on Friday; have you heard of any other locations or drop-off times?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’d heard Rosa mention Sunday at the community center, but if your confirmed time is Friday at the school gym after pickup, I’ll treat mine as unconfirmed and double-check before sending supplies anywhere.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Cleo—I'll keep Sunday at the community center marked as unconfirmed until Rosa verifies it, and for now we’ll route supplies to the school gym Friday after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Quinn, I’m still a little fuzzy on the repair drive details, but I told Jules I’d double-check the priority repairs and tool list before passing anything along.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Noah — I’ve got Leo bringing the basic tools and covering the repair table, but I still need to confirm the priority repairs and final schedule with Rosa before we spread specifics.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, thanks Quinn — I’ll hold off on telling folks specifics until you’ve checked with Rosa, and I’ll focus on matching Jules’ donation sorting to whatever priority repairs you confirm.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I still don’t have any new updates, Leo. Best to check the bulletin or organizer so we have the exact time and repair list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it, I’ll check the bulletin and confirm with the organizer before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Leo. Once you hear the confirmed time, let me know and I’ll stick to bringing my screwdrivers and pliers Saturday morning if that’s still useful.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Pia, I’m checking on the repair drive for Saturday morning—Sam’s bringing a drill and hammer, Oren’s looking for screws and tape, and Leo’s got screwdrivers and pliers, so do you know anyone with a socket set or anything that needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can ask around about a socket set, but I’m still verifying the exact drop-off spot and timing so we don’t send people to the wrong place.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, thanks Pia—hold off on spreading the spot until you confirm it, and I’ll tell folks we’ve got tools coming together but still need that socket set.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Uli, quick version—I’m slammed, but I’m planning to bring a screwdriver set, work gloves, and spare tape or screws for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo — that’s exactly the kind of thing folks can use for lamps and small appliances. I’ll pass it along to Rosa once she confirms the time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks—just text me the confirmed time when Rosa has it, and I’ll swing by with the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Rey, once you’ve checked for screwdrivers, pliers, and tape measures, bring me the gaps and I’ll match them against the sign-up sheet.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Okay, Mara — I’ll check those first and bring you just the missing tools so you can match them cleanly.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, thank you — I’ll stay by the sign-up sheet, and once you’re back we’ll see if we need to pull Noah over to the tool table.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hi Nell — I’m still waiting on fresh repair drive details, but I’m checking the bulletin when I get back inside and spreading the word while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira — I’m holding off on passing along the Saturday morning rumor until Rosa confirms it, but I’m setting aside screwdrivers and pliers just in case.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds wise, Nell — I’ll keep it general for now and won’t mention Saturday morning unless Rosa confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Gus, quick update: the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and I’m checking who can still help—would you be able to pitch in with repairs or setup?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Rosa — I can pitch in with setup and bring my tool kit for repairs on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Gus, thank you — setup help and your tool kit will make a big difference. Could you plan to arrive a little early on Sunday so we can get the stations organized before neighbors come by?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Faye — that would be a huge help. Could you ask who can bring basic toolkits, extension cords, and any spare labels or tape so we can keep the repair tables organized?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely, Rosa — I’ll message the parent list for toolkits, extension cords, labels, and tape, and I’ll note that it’s Sunday at the community center so nobody follows the old school pickup plan.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you, Faye — that clear note about Sunday at the community center will save us a lot of confusion. If you hear of any gaps, send them my way and I’ll match them with the other volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Dane, got it—I’ll bring the screwdriver set, gloves, and spare tape or screws Saturday and drop them at the donation table when I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Bo — that’s perfect. I’ll make sure the donation table is ready so you can just drop everything there when you get in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks—I'll just swing by and drop them there Saturday, then keep moving unless you need me for anything else.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Oren — I heard you might bring screws, tape, and an extension cord for the repair drive. Is that still right, so I can tell Cleo what’s covered?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, yes — I’m still trying to round up screws, tape, and an extension cord for the repair drive. Go ahead and tell Cleo that’s the plan, and I’ll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren — I’ll let Cleo know that’s the plan, and I’ll keep it as “what you can bring” until you’ve got it gathered.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Uli — if you can bring those basic tools, I’ll have the lamps and small appliances table ready when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll bring them, Gus. Just tell me what time to come by, and I’ll keep to the lamps and small appliances table.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Come by around 10 if that works, Uli — I’ll have a spot cleared and we’ll start with the lamps before the appliances.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m not comfortable announcing it yet until we’ve pinned down the time, drop-off spot, and whether Rey is definitely coordinating. I’ll check those now and circle back before anyone shares the flyer.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds sensible, Pia—best to wait until Rey and the bulletin confirm the time and drop-off spot. I’ll hold off sharing anything and just keep my screwdrivers and pliers ready for Saturday morning if that stays the plan.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Eli — please keep them ready but don’t count on Saturday morning until I’ve confirmed the 10 to 2 window, the drop-off spot, and Rey’s role.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Opal, if you can make it Saturday morning, bring pliers or a socket set if you’ve got one.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Leo—I’ll note Saturday morning as tentative, but I’m holding off on sharing until Pia or Ira confirm the exact time and location. If it’s confirmed, I can bring pliers.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good. It’s Saturday morning in the community room—bring the pliers if that works.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still waiting on Rosa to confirm the time and location, Quinn, but once she sends it I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Nell — I’ll hold off on nudging anyone else with specifics until Rosa confirms, but I’ll be ready to spread the word fast once you hear back.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Perfect, thanks, Quinn — I’ll keep it to “details coming soon” for now and send you Rosa’s confirmed info the moment I have it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Ira, I’m checking the repair drive supplies now—Oren may bring screws, tape, and an extension cord, and Rey has basic tools covered, so I’m looking for any gaps before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Cleo — I haven’t seen a fresh bulletin yet, but I’ll check when I’m back inside and spread the word if you need any extra supplies filled before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Ira — that’d be a big help. I’ll finish my supply check and let you know if we’re short on anything specific before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How’s the repair drive going, Jules? Do you still need help with anything?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming together — I’m confirming the top repair needs and signup count, then matching folks to tools and supplies. If you can help, tell me what time you’re free Saturday morning and what you can bring.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m free Saturday from 9 to 11, and I can bring labels, bins, and a basic tool kit. Do you want me sorting by the folding tables near the entrance?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hana, could you take the sign-in sheet at the entrance and point donors toward the folding tables? Noah’s sorting there now, and I’m checking missing tools with Rey.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can do that, Mara—just to confirm, is the drive happening now at the entrance, and are the folding tables definitely the donor drop-off spot?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, exactly—sign-in at the entrance, and send donors to the folding tables for drop-off. Noah’s sorting there now, so just point folks his way.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m a bit scattered today. What still needs doing, and when is it again?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s this Saturday morning in the community room, and we could still use extra tools like a socket set if anyone has one. I’m also hoping for a good turnout, so I’m planning to stop by and see what they need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it—Saturday morning in the community room, thanks. I’ll double-check the priority repairs and tool list like I promised Jules, and I’ll see if I can rustle up a socket set too.
